    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_row = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row))

                r = marker_row - distance
                if r >= 0:
                    out[r][col] = value if distance == above else 1
    return out
'''
